contentText:
This is partner content.

The NAACP Image Awards 2026 were full of wins and artists making history. Keep watching to see the impact that Teyana Taylor, Olivia Dean and more have made!

Narrator:

The culture is evolving. The charts are shifting, and in 2026 the artists leading both are impossible to ignore. As the NAACP Image Awards sets the stage, the story moves from Kendrick Lamar’s continued artistic reign to new rising stars like Olivia Dean. Let’s get into it. This is Billboard News presented by Lexus. K-Dot’s impact remains unmatched, setting the tone for a year defined by bold storytelling and cultural power. He recently surpassed Jay-Z and Kanye West to become the winningest hip-hop Grammy Award winner of all time, with 27 total wins. Teyana Taylor has proven she’s a true multihyphenate, shaping both Hollywood and the music industry with her dual presence. She shined in ‘Straw,’ ‘All Is Fair,’ ‘The RIP’ and ‘One Battle After Another,’ which earned her a best supporting actress Oscar nomination and Golden Globe win. With hits like “Hard Part” and “Bed of Roses,” her album ‘Escape Room’ landed her a top 25 spot on the RnB/Hip-Hop Album chart and earned Teyana her first ever Grammy nomination.

Crystal Renee Hayslett:

It feels amazing to see all my girls out here doing it. The first person that comes to mind is Teyana Taylor. She is killing I want to give you your flowers. You are doing the thing I’m so inspired.

Keep watching for more!
